title: CANON-CORE Extension Header
description: Schema for the extension declaration block that project CANON files must include when extending CANON-CORE. Validated by audit-claims to verify project CANONs are properly declaring extends: CANON-CORE and documenting any invariant overrides with justification.

status.description: Current status of the project CANON document

signed.description: SIG-ID of the agent that last modified this CANON file. Format: SIG-YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ-[agent]-[hash4]

override_justification.description: Why this invariant cannot apply to this domain. Must be substantive (minimum 20 characters). State the domain incompatibility and how the spirit of the invariant is still upheld.

overrides.description: List of CANON-CORE invariants overridden by this project. Each override requires a mandatory justification. Projects without domain conflicts should not declare overrides.

overrides.override_justification: Fractal Waves is a mathematics-only domain. Biology-inclusive language in Invariant 1 references (e.g., Cellico terminology) creates domain incompatibility. All data still traced to source — mathematical derivations cited to proof or algorithm reference.
